issues.failure_explanation: Every root of p(xi)=e^{lambda h} gives zero loss, so it is a global minimizer. For RK2 the other root z1=-2-z2 has |z1|>1 and Im(z1)=-Im(z2) when Re(lambda)=0, so the rotation direction is reversed. For RK3 the remaining root has Re(z1)<-1, contradicting Re>0. The proofs analyse only the root in the disc |xi|<=1 (or <=delta). Thm rk_diss even claims a unique global minimizer in C, which is false.
